text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph explanation with several distinct reasons","quality":"development","description":"The writing supports its main claim with multiple elaborated points rather than a single brief example."},{"evidence":"longer chains like \"If a project is too big and impossible... they could split up the work\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay expands ideas with added explanation that makes the argument more fully developed."},{"evidence":"\"For example, when I had a final project...\" and similar personal examples","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"The essay uses relevant examples to back up its points more consistently and effectively."},{"evidence":"\"Also,\" \"Another reason,\" \"Another way,\" \"However\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses clearer transitions and paragraph structure to connect reasons and guide the reader."},{"evidence":"\"Working with partners is beneficial to students, because...\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows more control of sentence framing and clause structure, even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"mostly consistent academic argument about partners and projects","quality":"task focus","description":"The essay stays more consistently on one line of reasoning and maintains a clearer overall purpose."}]}
